name: ai-gateway.classify-batch
purpose: Classify up to 32 texts using caller-owned instructions and labels, retaining ordered per-item failures, validated labels, provider identity and measured usage in one bounded batch.

corpus.description: 1 to 32 nonempty texts; at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes each and 65536 total.

labels.description: 1 to 32 distinct nonempty strings; at most 64 UTF-8 bytes each.

instruction.description: Caller-owned classification instruction; 1 to 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

assumptions: AI Gateway serves the classify.fast role through its governed batch binding.
invariants: The envelope is printed exactly once on every execution path.
One batch RPC at most; provider validation repair remains bounded by AI Gateway.
Only validated values in the declared label set contribute to labels or counts.
Every requested index is retained when a positional result is missing or invalid.
Input texts and provider output text are not copied into the result envelope.

signals.results: Ordered item evidence, including null labels and indexed errors for failures.
signals.labels: Labels in input order, null for invalid or absent results.
signals.usage: Owner-supplied batch usage; null when unavailable or invalid.

outputs.evidence: Batch binding, role and request/item counts; provider identity and measured usage live in item evidence.
